The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally calls `_unflatten_snapshots` for snapshot-dimensional arrays attached to a network, without checking linopy semantics or the snapshot-index option. For an array with an object-valued snapshot index of tuples and matching auxiliary level coordinates, this converts the snapshot index to a pandas MultiIndex before conversion to pandas, whereas the base implementation leaves the flat index intact. Thus such an input can produce a different result even under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`.
